serving_config:
[program:higmem-vllm]
command=/venv/main/bin/vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18080 --language-model-only --dtype float16 --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 48 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 --enable-prefix-caching --reasoning-parser qwen3
directory=/workspace/HiGMem
environment=HF_HOME="/workspace/.hf_home",OMP_NUM_THREADS="4"
autostart=false
autorestart=false
redirect_stderr=true
stdout_logfile=/workspace/HiGMem/vllm.log
stdout_logfile_maxbytes=50000000
stdout_logfile_backups=1
stopasgroup=true
killasgroup=true
